LanguageData.VGE_Warplatform.letterDesc:
An orbital bombardment platform has been activated by your Hellion's energy signature. It is currently running target scans and will engage shortly. The orbital platform houses a sensitive warcomputer; destroying this component will disable the platform entirely.

The platform will continue to fire on your Hellion until you move out of range or it is destroyed. Be aware that it takes time to fully engage; if you move away quickly enough, you may be able to escape its detection.

Point defense turrets, gravarmor, and shield generators can be used to protect against the bombardment. Hellion artillery can be used to attack the enemy over long distances. You can also send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to handle it personally.
LanguageData.VGE_Warplatform.arrivalLetterDesc: An orbital bombardment warplatform has arrived and is actively engaging your Hellion. Your aircraft will be under continuous fire from the platform's weapons. To survive, you must neutralize the platform either by destroying all gauss bombards, or destroying or hacking the central warcomputer.\n\nYou can fight back using your Hellion's artillery, shield generators, and point defenses to withstand the bombardment. Alternatively, send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to board the platform and destroy its sensitive internal warcomputer directly. If you cannot stop the bombardment, you must attempt to escape its range immediately.
LanguageData.VGE_Warplatform.disengagesLetterDesc: Warplatform has achieved all pre-programmed goals and has effectively destroyed your Hellion. It has now disengaged.\n\nConsider this a valuable lesson.
LanguageData.VGE_Warplatform.alertExplanation: An enemy warplatform has targeted {0}. It will continuously bombard the Hellion until it is destroyed. Destroy or hack the internal warcomputer, or try to escape.
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerStation.letterDesc:
An incoming transmission has been intercepted from a nearby salvager station, {0}. Its leader, {1}, has issued a demand for tribute.

The station has locked its weapons on {2} and will open fire unless you pay a tribute of {3} silver. You are being given time to deliberate, but you must choose quickly: you can pay the full amount to secure your safety, or request to postpone the payment by {4} days. Be warned that choosing to delay will force a remote lock on your Hellion engine, preventing you from departing. If you refuse to pay, the station will initiate an immediate attack.

If it attacks, the salvager station will continue to fire on your Hellion until you move out of range or it is destroyed.

Point defense turrets, gravarmor, and shield generators can be used to protect against the bombardment. Hellion artillery can be used to attack the enemy over long distances. You can also send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to handle it personally.
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerStation.arrivalLetterDesc: A salvager orbital station has locked in and is engaging your Hellion. Your aircraft will be under continuous fire from the numerous artillery pieces and missile launchers. To survive, you must destroy enemy Hellion artillery pieces and the gravlock tether.\n\nYou can fight back using your Hellion's artillery, shield generators, and point defenses to withstand the bombardment. Alternatively, send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to board the orbital platform and destroy the gravlock tether and Hellion artillery pieces. If you cannot stop the bombardment, you must attempt to escape its range immediately.
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerStation.disengagesLetterDesc: The salvager station has destroyed your Hellion engine. They are celebrating. You should have paid the tribute.\n\nConsider this a valuable lesson.
LanguageData.VGE_SalvagerStation.alertExplanation: A salvager orbital station has targeted {0}. It will continuously bombard the Hellion until it is destroyed. You can destroy the enemy Hellion artillery pieces and the gravlock tether, or try to escape. If you escape, salvagers will likely send a search party.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumper.label: Enemy Hellion Fighter
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumper.letterDesc:
An enemy Hellion Fighter called {0} has intercepted your landing coordinates and is preparing to attack. It is currently running final scans to determine the best assault approach. The Hellion Fighter is a compact, short-range aircraft that relies on a Hellion Fighter engine and pilot cockpit. Its minimal deck support and footprint make it ideal for scouting and interception. Destroying the Hellion Fighter engine will disable it permanently.

The Hellion Fighter will continuously fire at your location until you move out of range or destroy it. It may decide to move in, in which case it will land in your local area and engage you up close. You can prevent this by destroying the thrusters, fuel tanks, or pilot cockpit. If you move away now, you may be able to shake it off.

Point defense turrets, gravarmor, and shield generators can be used to protect against the bombardment. Hellion artillery can be used to attack the enemy over long distances. You can also send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to handle it personally.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumper.arrivalLetterDesc: An enemy Hellion Fighter has arrived in orbit and begins the attack on your Hellion. Your aircraft will be under continuous fire from the Hellion Fighter's weapons. To survive, you must destroy the enemy Hellion Fighter engine, as well as eliminate all of its artillery turrets.\n\nYou can fight back using your Hellion's artillery, shield generators, and point defenses to withstand the bombardment. Alternatively, send a shuttle or drop pods to the enemy location to board the Hellion Fighter and destroy it from the inside. If you cannot defend yourself, you must attempt to escape its range immediately.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumper.escapedMessage: You have escaped the enemy Hellion Fighter.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumper.earlyEscapeMessage: You have escaped the enemy Hellion Fighter.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumper.defeatLetterDesc: Enemy Hellion Fighter threat has been defeated, but the area still offers valuable loot. You can salvage its wreck to gain some valuable resources.\n\nThe Hellion Fighter will destabilize and collapse within {0}.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumper.disengagesLetterDesc: {0} has effectively destroyed your Hellion. It has now disengaged.\n\nConsider this a valuable lesson.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravjumper.alertExplanation: An enemy Hellion Fighter has targeted {0}. It will continuously bombard the Hellion until it is destroyed. Destroy the enemy Hellion Fighter engine to permanently disable the aircraft.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalCluster.label: US Automated Aerospace Defense
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalCluster.letterDesc:
An orbital battery of the pre-War US Automated Aerospace Defense network has locked onto your Hellion's coordinates and is slowly moving into position to engage. This massive installation houses an automated defense-platform engine; destroying it will yield a reactor core. The battery carries numerous automated artillery units and is protected by a significant force of combat robots, all of which must be destroyed to defeat it.

The battery is part of an extensive military orbital-defense network. The relay alarm has registered your Hellion as an unauthorized aircraft, and its engine signature is being tracked relentlessly. Attempting to flee will only cause another battery to move into range and engage. You must prepare to neutralize this threat or face the consequences.

Point defense turrets, gravarmor, and shield generators can protect against the bombardment. Hellion artillery can attack the battery over long distances. You can also send a shuttle or drop pods to board the installation and disable it directly.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalCluster.arrivalLetterDesc: A US Automated Aerospace Defense battery has arrived and is actively engaging your Hellion. Your aircraft will be under continuous fire from the battery's weapons. To survive, you must neutralize the installation by destroying its defense-platform engine, all enemy artillery, and its combat robots.\n\nYou can fight back using your Hellion's artillery, shield generators, and point defenses to withstand the bombardment. Alternatively, send a shuttle or drop pods to board the battery and destroy its engine directly. If you cannot stop the bombardment, you must attempt to escape its range immediately, but another network battery will likely engage you again.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalCluster.escapedMessage: You have managed to escape the orbital defense battery.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalCluster.earlyEscapeMessage: You have managed to shake off the orbital defense battery.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalCluster.defeatLetterDesc: The orbital defense battery has been defeated, but the area still offers valuable loot. You can salvage its wreck for resources, but surviving combat robots may continue to resist.\n\nThe orbital defense battery will destabilize and collapse within {0}.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalCluster.disengagesLetterDesc: The orbital defense battery no longer perceives you as a threat and has effectively destroyed your Hellion. It has now disengaged.\n\nConsider this a valuable lesson.
LanguageData.VGE_OrbitalCluster.alertExplanation: A US Automated Aerospace Defense battery has targeted {0}. It will continuously bombard the Hellion until it is destroyed. Destroy the defense-platform engine, all enemy artillery pieces, and the defending robots, or try to escape. Another network battery will likely attack later.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravship.label: Enemy Hellion
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravship.letterDesc:
An enemy Hellion called {0} has successfully triangulated your landing coordinates and is moving into a high-orbit position to begin orbital bombardment. It is currently locking targeting sensors onto your position. A Hellion is a versatile mid-sized aircraft powered by a standard Hellion engine and launched via a pilot console. Balanced in size and support, it can serve as a mobile base with sufficient upgrades. Destroying the Hellion engine will disable it permanently.

The enemy Hellion will continuously fire at your location until you move out of range or destroy it. If you move away now, you may be able to shake it off.

Point defense turrets, gravarmor, and shield generators can protect against the bombardment. Hellion artillery can attack the enemy over long distances. You can also send a shuttle or drop pods to board it.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravship.arrivalLetterDesc: An enemy Hellion has arrived in orbit and begins the attack on your Hellion. Your aircraft will be under continuous fire from the enemy Hellion's weapons. To survive, you must destroy its Hellion engine, as well as eliminate all of its artillery turrets.\n\nYou can fight back using your Hellion's artillery, shield generators, and point defenses to withstand the bombardment. Alternatively, send a shuttle or drop pods to board the enemy Hellion and destroy it from the inside. If you cannot defend yourself, you must attempt to escape its range immediately.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravship.escapedMessage: You have escaped the enemy Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravship.earlyEscapeMessage: You have escaped the enemy Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravship.defeatLetterDesc: Enemy Hellion threat has been defeated, but the area still offers valuable loot. You can salvage its wreck to gain some valuable resources.\n\nThe Hellion will destabilize and collapse within {0}.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravship.disengagesLetterDesc: {0} has effectively destroyed your Hellion. It has now disengaged.\n\nConsider this a valuable lesson.
LanguageData.VGE_EnemyGravship.alertExplanation: An enemy Hellion has targeted {0}. It will continuously bombard the Hellion until it is destroyed. Destroy the enemy Hellion engine and its artillery to permanently disable the aircraft.
